interface.title: PetroLog
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and interpretation of a single well's wireline logs, from loading the raw LAS file to exporting a net-pay interpretation
interface.what_it_is_for: Load a LAS well log, view and clean its curves, compute porosity, shale volume and Archie water saturation, group depths into facies-like clusters, cross-plot curves, and apply cutoffs to pick net reservoir and net pay zones with a written interpretation and CSV/LAS exports.

data.note: I uploaded demo_well.las on the Upload tab: 1000–1059 m at 1 m steps with curves GR, RT, RHOB, NPHI and CALI. The null sentinels were cleaned to empty values (1030–1034 m is blank in the CSV export). The file has a pay sand at 1015–1029 m, a wet sand at 1035–1049 m and a caliper washout at 1050–1054 m. The other four tabs stay empty until a file is uploaded (seen before upload; that screen was not kept).

features.name: Well-log file loader with curve listing

features.specific: Upload tab: LAS file uploader → 'Curves found:' list (DEPTH, GR, RT, RHOB, NPHI, CALI plus added DEPTH_M and DEPTH_UNIT); null sentinels come through as empty values in later exports; other tabs stay empty until a file is loaded

features.name: Multi-track depth log viewer with depth window and markers
features.general: Show several measured variables as side-by-side tracks against depth, pick which variables go in each track, limit the depth range with a two-handle slider, draw horizontal reference lines at typed depths, and export the plot and the windowed data

type marker depths separated by commas
download the PNG or the windowed CSV

screens_never_reached: Fullscreen view of the plots and tables: I did not open it.
The data-grid toolbar on the zone tables (Show/hide columns, Search, built-in Download as CSV): it appears in the page structure, but I did not use it.
not_done: I could not colour the crossplot by cluster label. Color by (and the X/Y lists) only offer the raw curves GR, RT, RHOB, NPHI and CALI. Neither the cluster labels (CLUS) nor the computed curves (VSH, PHI, SW) appear there, even after running clustering and petrophysics (screens/028.webp, screens/029.webp). Part of the goal 'cross-plot colored by ... cluster label' was therefore not possible.

I could not run clustering on computed curves (VSH, PHI). Select features only lists the raw curves (screens/047.webp). The clustered tracks are fixed to GR, RT and NPHI/RHOB, so CALI is never shown even when it is used as a feature.
I did not try the Larionov (old) or Steiber VSH models. I did change the matrix/fluid density and Archie a/m/n inputs, but did not test them separately.

Downloading any file clears the button-gated results on the Clustering, Petrophysics and Interpretation tabs, so each further download needs a re-run. My first try at Download interval summary (CSV) produced an unreadable '30cae2ca47f6ffbba288acf13b07dc0d.bin'. It only worked after re-running the interpretation (interval_summary.csv).

After a widget change, the first click on Run clustering, Compute petrophysics or Run interpretation was often swallowed by the page refresh, and a second click was needed (trace steps 46–47, 78–80, 108–110, 129–131, 135–137, 165–167; the replay saw the same on t4, t7 and t9). The screens of the swallowed clicks were not kept.
My first attempts at the crossplot downloads by element reference timed out (trace steps 100–101); the points CSV was saved later by clicking the button on screen.

Unless 'Recompute petrophysics' is checked, the Interpretation tab uses the curves last computed on the Petrophysics tab (Larionov young, Rw 0.2, giving SW 0.302). Meanwhile it still shows its own VSH model and Rw as Linear and 0.100 (screens/035.webp compared with screens/039.webp). Results can therefore differ from the inputs shown on that tab.

The Quick viewer's depth axis switched to depth increasing upward (1060 at the top) after I changed the window and tracks, whereas the first view and the Petrophysics plots put 1000 m at the top (screens/006.webp compared with screens/009.webp). I did not track down what triggers this.
I did not open or check the PNG downloads (tracks_1010-1059m.png, and the crossplot PNG from the first attempt); only the text exports were read.
Neither run downloaded the interpreted CSV from the Interpretation tab, and the replay did not test 'Recompute petrophysics' or download the narrative .txt.
